messages:
ming zhang: Heads-up — after the 4-bit quant bring-up of m3-small-q4, our zh->en and en->zh tests show a weird token boundary regression when input mixes CJK + non-CJK scripts (Greek/Arabic/Latin punctuation). Sample from nightly eval:

ming zhang: eval alert: BLEU zh->en dropped 3.8, chrF dropped 5.3 on mixed-script subset. repro below.

ming zhang: repro snippet:
```
src: 我喜欢这个模型—it feels fast, αλλά έχει weird tokens.
tokenized: [我, 喜, 欢, 这, 个, 模, 型, —, it,  , fe, el, s,  , α, λ, λ, ά,  , έ, χ, ε, ι, ,  , w, e, i, r, d,  , t, o, k, e, n, s, .]
expected tokenization: Chinese chars kept, latin/greek separated but not fragmenting non-latin sequences oddly
```

ming zhang: Also saw Arabic RTL punctuation being attached to prior CJK char: example "学习،اللغة" tokenized into [学, 习،ال, لغ, ة] instead of [学, 习, ،, ال, لغ, ة] which breaks detokenize and degrades BLEU.

rajiv patel: @ming zhang thanks. Is this strictly a tokenizer change from the new tokenizers wheel or something in the runtime kv-cache alignment after quant?

ming zhang: initial bisect points to tokenizer lib bump in the model build container (tokenizers 0.14.x -> 0.15.2) combined with our altered normalization path during quantization. Could be fallback to byte-level splits for non-BMP/RTL clusters.

lisa chen: FWIW we saw a similar surface before, but that was a token merging bug in runtime that impacted CJK+emoji. This smells like segmentation rules (UAX #29) not being applied consistently after we normalized to NFKC during compile.

anna morozova: eval-bot posted a regression alert earlier: see commit abc123 (model build) triggered failing gating tests.

eval-bot: Regression detected: nightly/m3-small-q4 mixed-script-suite: chrF -5.3, BLEU -3.8, failing examples: 42/200. See /runs/2026-03-18/17798/run-42 for examples.

rajiv patel: Can you paste the minimal tokenizer repro + exact package diff? If it's the wheel bump we can roll back or pin.

ming zhang: package diff:
```
- tokenizers==0.14.3
+ tokenizers==0.15.2
- sentencepiece==0.1.97
+ sentencepiece==0.1.98
```
minimal repro using huggingface tokenizers:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('m3_vocab.json')
print(t.encode("我喜欢这个模型—it feels fast, αλλά έχει weird tokens.").tokens)
```
produces fragmented greek/latin sequences on 0.15.2, not on 0.14.3

lisa chen: two actionable paths: (1) pin tokenizers->0.14.3 while we investigate, (2) add explicit UAX29 segmentation step pre-tokenize (low-risk patch) + add unit tests for mixed-script corpora.

anna morozova: +1 for tests + patch. We should also add mixed-script lines to the nightly eval set so this doesn't sneak by. I'll sync with infra to add a gating test.

ming zhang: I'll try the UAX29 normalization shim and run a quick compare. If that fixes, we can keep newer wheels and add the shim until tokenizers upstream resolves. Will post diffs here.

rajiv patel: Also check kv-cache indexing — tokenizer length differences could shift kv cache read offsets post-quant; that would explain ngram-level artifacts in generation. But your examples look pre-detokenize, so tokenization is prime suspect.

ming zhang: good point — I'll run a decode-level alignment test: generate with raw token ids compare pre/post quantized runtime.

lisa chen: add testcases: (a) CJK + Greek inside a word, (b) CJK + Arabic with RTL punctuation, (c) mixed CJK + ASCII quotes and em-dash. Put them into /eng-ml/evals/mixed-script-regressions.jsonl and wire into nightly.

ming zhang: quick patch attempt: inserted python uax29 preprocessor using regex from unicode.org. preliminary run: chrF delta -> -0.6 (much smaller). Pushing branch: refs/heads/eng-ml/tokenizer-uax29-shim-177980

eval-bot: CI job tokenizer-shim checks: 12/15 small unit tests passed, 3 failing on edge-case emoji+CJK sequences.

anna morozova: great progress. If CI passes with shim and we add gating evals, let's keep 0.15.2 pinned for 48h while we triage upstream. We need a short postmortem note for eng-oncall + release notes if we revert.

ming zhang: I'll open a GH issue against tokenizers with minimal repro + our shim as a suggested patch. Linking here once done.

rajiv patel: thanks all. After the fix lands, we should rerun quantized model throughput vs. perf matrix to ensure we didn't regress latency/throughput tradeoffs.

lisa chen: putting action items: 1) ming: push shim PR + repro GH issue; 2) anna: add mixed-script gating evals; 3) rajiv: run kv-cache alignment tests; 4) me: add unit test matrix for emoji+CJK. Deadline EOD tomorrow. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

ming zhang: ack, will update thread with PR + eval links. :thumbsup:
